Cosmic Omen is a subclass-specific resource for Druids of the Circle of the Stars.

Overview

Cosmic Omens are a limited resource that allow Circle of the Stars druids to manipulate fate through reactions and supportive abilities. Upon reaching Level 6, these druids gain the passive feature  Cosmic Omen, which grants either an omen of Weal or Woe after each Long Rest.

  • Weal omens allow druids to add +1d6 to allied Attack rolls and Saving throws, and grant bonuses to Ability Checks.
  • Woe omens allow druids to subtract +1d6 from enemy Attack rolls and Saving throws.

Circle of the Stars druids gain 3 Cosmic Omens at Level 6 and an additional Cosmic Omen at Level 9.

Recovering Cosmic Omens

Cosmic Omens are fully replenished upon long resting or respeccing with Withers.
